title: Ask HN: Where do those LLM-generated outreach emails come from?
excerpt: I have started getting daily LLM-written outreach emails. They all follow the same exact pattern, but come from different people pitching different vibe-coded things. The authors are real people with LinkedIn profiles, usually AI gurus, rarely experts in their niche. The message is usually targeted compliment > pitch > call to action. The compliment is the biggest tell because it's so neat and specific.
content_html:
I have started getting daily LLM-written outreach emails. They all follow the same exact pattern, but come from different people pitching different vibe-coded things. The authors are real people with LinkedIn profiles, usually AI gurus, rarely experts in their niche. The message is usually targeted compliment > pitch > call to action. The compliment is the biggest tell because it's so neat and specific.

My question: which tool are they all using? Why has it become so popular almost overnight? How do I reliably block those emails?

content_html_zh:
我已经开始每天收到法学硕士撰写的外展电子邮件。 它们都遵循相同的模式，但来自不同的人，推销不同的氛围编码的东西。 作者是拥有 LinkedIn 个人资料的真实人士，通常是人工智能专家，很少是其领域的专家。 该信息通常是有针对性的赞美 > 宣传 > 号召性用语。 赞美是最重要的，因为它是如此简洁和具体。

我的问题：他们都使用哪种工具？ 为什么它几乎一夜之间变得如此受欢迎？ 如何可靠地阻止这些电子邮件？
